title: Kestrel Delivery Pass Terms: Refund of a Subscription Fee on Cancellation (Delivery & Pickup Services)
content:
When a Delivery & Pickup Services plan is cancelled, a subscription fee already charged is refunded on these terms.

1. **Within the full-refund window.** A subscription fee is refunded in full, as a cancellation within the trial or refund window, when the plan is cancelled no later than the plan's full-refund window days after that fee was charged.
2. **After the window.** After that, where the plan refunds unused whole months after the window, the unused whole months of the cycle are refunded as a prorated cancellation, each month worth the subscription fee divided by the billing-cycle months and rounded to the cent half up.
3. **Otherwise** nothing is refunded.

The full-refund window, whether unused months are refunded and the subscription figures are the plan's own terms in the Delivery & Pickup Services schedules.

## The terms as a decision table

| Cancelled within the full-refund window of the fee | Plan refunds unused whole months after the window | Refund of that subscription fee |
|---|---|---|
| yes | any | the fee in full |
| no | yes | the unused whole months, each worth the fee divided by the cycle months |
| no | no | nothing |

The window is counted in calendar days after the date the fee was charged; cancelling on the last day of the window is within it.

## Worked figures (Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual: $48.00 for a 12-month cycle, 30-day window)

- **Monthly worth.** $48.00 divided by 12 months is $4.00 a month.
- **Within the window.** Fee charged on 1 March, plan cancelled on 31 March (30 days after): refunded in full, $48.00.
- **Just after the window.** Fee charged on 1 March, plan cancelled on 1 April (31 days after): the full refund no longer applies; with, hypothetically, 10 unused whole months left in the cycle, the refund is 10 months at $4.00, $40.00.
- **Hypothetical 7 unused whole months:** 7 months at $4.00, $28.00.

On Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly and Kestrel Senior Delivery Pass the full-refund window is 0 days and unused months are not refunded, so a fee is refunded in full only when the plan is cancelled on the day the fee was charged, and otherwise nothing is refunded.
